recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Future work should avoid reintroducing Element-page copies of XML/JSON syntax rules unless a new work-group decision requires local Element-specific guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-18414 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I clarification from the STU3 ballot asking to drop the Element page's XML and JSON representation section because that syntax guidance was redundant with the XML and JSON syntax pages and did not cover RDF.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 7c6b930880820a97fb1515a3ec096dfc24130a7e, which removed the XML and JSON Representation of Elements and XML and JSON Representation of Primitive Types sections from source/types.html. That commit is included in the v5.0.0 history.
additional_context: The current build maps Element to the Type Framework page through source/fhir.ini's active type-page entry element=types. Current source/types.html retains the Element definition, constraints, and Internal Id Scope text but no longer contains the old representation headings or anchors. The XML and JSON pages now cover resource/element representation, primitive value/id/extension handling, repeated elements, and complex datatype examples. FHIR-I minutes for 2019-04-22 match the Jira disposition, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because the requested obsolete Element syntax sections have already been removed from the current in-build source, while the XML and JSON syntax pages provide the relevant representation guidance.
